description: AI for Thai is the Thai AI service platform run by NECTEC (National Electronics and Computer Technology Center, part of NSTDA) in Pathum Thani, Thailand. It exposes NECTEC's own Thai-language AI as APIs, including Partii speech recognition and Vaja text-to-speech, free with rate limits for study and testing; commercial use is arranged with NECTEC. Registration is required to obtain an API key.
name: AI for Thai (NECTEC)
